{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
'''"Doe Azalus Ootmian"''' ("Dangerous Stranger" in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]]) was a popular [[Music/Legends|tune]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era. The band [[South Sector Boppers]] played this song.<ref name="blog">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
"Doe Azalus Ootmian" is background music heard in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Players can select it in [[Jukebox/Legends|jukeboxes]] using a jukebox token. It was composed by [[Jared Emerson-Johnson]].
